content:
Returns a list of assets that have been excluded from the specified dynamic tag. If no tags are
assigned to the asset, Tenable Vulnerability Management returns an empty list.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The unique identifiers (UUID) of the tag value you want to list asset
exclusions for. For more information on determining this value, see
Determine Tag Identifiers.
QUERY PARAMETERS
string
Default: "assets"
Value: "assets"
The type of target to list tag exclusions for. This value is always assets .
integer <int32>
Default: 100
The number of records to retrieve. If this parameter is omitted, Tenable
Vulnerability Management uses the default value of 100 .
integer <int32>
Default: 0
The starting record to retrieve. If this parameter is omitted, Tenable
Vulnerability Management uses the default value of 0 .
